parsed_entries.requirement: The Data Protection Board of India must include at least one expert in the field of law.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Data Protection Board of India includes at least one legal expert.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures the Board has legal expertise to fulfill its duties.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Chairperson and other Members of the Data Protection Board shall not be varied to their disadvantage after their appointment.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the terms of the Chairperson and Members are not varied to their disadvantage after appointment.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement protects the terms of the Board members from being altered unfavorably.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Chairperson and other Members of the Data Protection Board shall hold office for a term of two years and be eligible for re-appointment.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the term of office for the Chairperson and Members is two years with eligibility for re-appointment.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement establishes the term and re-appointment eligibility for Board members.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Chairperson or a Member of the Data Protection Board shall resign upon the Central Government's permission or upon expiry of three months from the notice of resignation.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the resignation of the Chairperson or Member is effective upon Central Government's permission or after three months.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement outlines the conditions for resignation of Board members.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Chairperson and Members of the Data Protection Board shall not accept employment with any Data Fiduciary against whom proceedings were initiated.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Chairperson and Members of the Board accept employment with Data Fiduciaries against whom proceedings were initiated.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement prevents conflicts of interest by prohibiting employment with entities under investigation.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Central Government shall be informed of any defect in the appointment of a person acting as the Chairperson or other Member of the Board.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Central Government is informed of any defect in the appointment of the Chairperson or Members.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures transparency in the appointment process of the Board members.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Board may appoint officers and employees as necessary for the efficient discharge of its functions, with prior approval from the Central Government.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Board has the authority to appoint officers and employees with prior Central Government approval.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement allows the Board to function efficiently by appointing necessary personnel.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Chairperson, Members, officers, and employees of the Data Protection Board shall be deemed public servants under the Indian Penal Code.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Chairperson, Members, officers, and employees of the Board are deemed public servants under the Indian Penal Code.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement grants the Board members and staff the status of public servants, ensuring accountability and legal protections.
